doc.brief: The QScrollerProperties class stores the settings for a [QScroller](xref:qt:QScroller).
doc.index_brief: Stores the settings for a QScroller

QVariant scrollMetric(QScrollerPropertie.brief: Query the *metric* value of the scroller properties.

bool operator!=(const QScrollerPropertie.brief: Returns `true` if these scroller properties are different from *sp*; otherwise returns `false`.

bool operator==(const QScrollerPropertie.brief: Returns `true` if these scroller properties are equal to *sp*; otherwise returns `false`.

void setDefaultScrollerProperties(const.brief: Sets the scroller properties for all new [QScrollerProperties](xref:qt:QScrollerProperties) objects to *sp*.

void setScrollMetric(QScrollerProperties.brief: Set a specific value of the *metric* ScrollerMetric to *value*.

void unsetDefaultScrollerProperties().brief: Sets the scroller properties returned by the default constructor back to the platform default properties.
